subject: Post-call recap & regression safeguard plan for Luminex
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sam Weston <sam.weston@luminex.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 18:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & regression safeguard plan for Luminex

Hi Sam / Tina —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment: 

- Observed objectives: you want a model that preserves factual precision on tariff/regulatory prompts and reduces hallucinations on legal clauses while keeping response latency < 400ms for single-turn lookups.
- Recommended starting models: Redwood-7B-ql (quantized) for throughput testing + Redwood-13B-finetune for quality checks.

Immediate actions I’ll own this week:
1) Send an evaluation pack with benchmark prompts, prompt sets, and a small golden set for regression checks (attached).
2) Run a quick A/Busing both recommended variants against your sample corpus and share summary results by Tuesday.
3) Define pin/rollback criteria so your integration is protected if the hosted model upgrades produce a quality delta.

Ask from you: please send the 150-200 sample queries you care most about (legal + tariff examples) so we can fold them into the golden set.

Attachments: luminex_eval_pack_v1.zip (benchmarks + small metrics CSV), prompt_set_legal.csv, diff_examples.txt

I’ll copy the ops/PM leads internally and loop back with the results and a proposed pin criterion (e.g. top-line pass rate drop > 3% on goldens triggers snapshot & temporary pin).

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Sam Weston <sam.weston@luminex.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Tina Park <tina@luminex.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 19:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & regression safeguard plan for Luminex

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the recap and the fast turnaround. A couple points from our side after the demo: 

- We started a short integration test this morning and noticed a measurable drop on a handful of prompts compared to your notes from last week. Examples attached (excerpted). Some answers now omit required regulatory citations. This is concerning because a missing citation is a hard-fail for our compliance reviewers.
- We are evaluating whether to proceed with the pilot this quarter; we need a clear rollback/pinning guarantee or at least an emergency freeze path.

I’ve attached a short list of failing examples (see diff_examples.txt) and our canonical expected outputs. We’ll share the 200-sample list by Monday.

Can Redwood guarantee a snapshot-and-pin option if a hosted model update causes a degradation? If so, what’s the process and SLA?

— Sam
Sam Weston
Head of Integrations, Luminex AI
sam.weston@luminex.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 20:12:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Re: Post-call recap & regression safeguard plan for Luminex

Looping in operability notes. Key options we should propose back to Luminex: 

1) Pin by model-version snapshot (hosted): we can snapshot an exact model artifact and pin traffic for their API key. That is supported but requires ops lead to apply a pin and we need a documented rollback window (48 hours SLA to enact pin for Dedicated/Private; hosted best-effort within 4 hours for priority customers).

2) Canary + auto-metrics: rollouts can be gated by golden-set pass rate. We should propose a concrete threshold (e.g., fail if goldens drop > 3% F1 or if any critical-citation prompts fail).

3) Emergency fallback: route to previous variant that passed the golden set or to a conservative smaller model that preserves citations (lower hallucination).

Action items for internal:
- Priyom: run the eval pack Sam attached against the most recent hosted snapshot and produce summary (diff by prompt, token delta, latency).
- Rishi: pull up SLA language for pinning and get internal ops estimate on timeline for hosted pin enforcements.

I’ll draft language for the customer that keeps commitments narrow and operationally feasible.

Rishi

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sam Weston <sam.weston@luminex.ai>
Cc: Tina Park <tina@luminex.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 22:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & regression safeguard plan for Luminex

Sam / Tina —

Thanks for the examples, that was helpful to triage quickly. Proposal and next steps below (concrete and time-boxed):

1) Short-term safeguard (within 48h): we will run your attached diff_examples.txt and the eval pack across the latest hosted snapshot. Priyom will deliver a CSV with per-prompt deltas and a shortlist of 8-10 critical failures. Expect that by Monday 03/05 EOD. (Link to run: https://redwood-internal/ops/run/98765)

2) Emergency pin policy (what we will commit): if the golden-set pass rate drops by >3% or if any of your top-20 critical prompts lose their required citation text, Redwood will:
   - snapshot the last passing artifact and enable a temporary pin on your API key (estimated enforcement within 4 hours for prioritized customers)
   - open an incident and provide a remediation ETA (ops contact + runbook attached)

3) Medium-term: we will run an A/B on Redwood-7B-ql vs Redwood-13B-finetune using your 200-sample list once you provide it. We’ll share a bench report with per-metric breakdown and a recommended production pin candidate.

4) Deliverables & links:
   - Eval pack (attached): luminex_eval_pack_v1.zip
   - Prompt set: prompt_set_legal.csv
   - Initial run link: https://redwood-internal/ops/run/98765
   - Benchmarks folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2B3cLuminex-Benchmarks
   - HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1127

If this sounds acceptable I’ll confirm the SLA language and send a short mutual action plan to lock the pilot timeline. Appreciate the quick sample list — that will let us finalize the golden set and the gating thresholds.

Best,
Lauren
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
